meta.name: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me
meta.description: Sato may be the most beautiful girl in school but she's also the coldest, never smiling at anyone. When her classmate Oshio spots her at a café, he learns Sato's secret: she's actually just shy and clumsy. As Sato and Oshio bond over their shared interests in photography and desserts, a sweet romance starts to blossom between two socially awkward people.

videos.title: The Cold Sato-san
videos.overview: Sota encounters Koharu, who is known as the "Cold Sato-san," at his family's cafe where he works part-time.

videos.title: A Second First Love
videos.overview: Koharu invites Sota to learn how to capture Minstagram-worthy photos at popular places.

videos.title: The End of Their Mutual Crush
videos.overview: Sota reveals his feelings for Koharu in an unexpected way.

videos.title: Magic
videos.overview: After a misunderstanding, Sota invites Koharu's father to the cafe for a discussion.

videos.title: Now Serving: Mutual Feelings
videos.overview: Sota and Koharu are officially a couple. Sota visits Rinka for relationship advice.

videos.title: The Beach, a Cat, and Love Talk
videos.overview: Koharu makes friends with Madoka after talking about their love lives.

videos.title: The Lovers' Lock
videos.overview: Koharu gets motivated to enjoy the beach with Sota after talking to Madoka.

videos.title: Can’t Help Falling in Love With You
videos.overview: Koharu realizes she's fallen for Sota multiple times over the years.
